description: Multi Split: splits up to sixteen polyphonic inputs across sixteen outputs, in as many separate groups as you patch inputs for

inputs.text: Shares its channels across the output of its own row and of every row below it, down to the next patched input. Patching it regroups the module, and its lamp glows red when the channels cannot fit

outputs.text: Carries part of the channels of the nearest patched input at or above its own row. Channels are shared as evenly as they divide, the higher outputs taking the remainder, and a spare output gives 0V

menu: Channels, in an output's own port menu — Auto shares whatever is left, and 1 to 16 fixes the count; the fixed outputs take their channels first
Channels, under the heading Configure all output ports: on the module's own menu — sets every output port's channel count at once
